supporting_pages.title: About read pools \_|\_ Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL \_|\_ Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: You can scale your read pool in several ways: Scale in or out : scale load balancing capacity horizontally by modifying the number of read pool nodes in the read pool.
If you want to convert a regional read replica to a read pool, then you must first convert the regional read replica to a zonal read replica.
Scale up or down : scale load balancing capacity vertically by modifying the machine type associated with a read pool node.
